text_block_list.text: After persuading Sakura Laurel, we headed to Tokyo Racecourse, where the Japanese Derby was being held.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
choice_data_list: (...I feel like I'm putting her through something cruel.)

text_block_list.text: After all, I'm having her spectate the Derby—the very race she gave up on and turned away from.

If she requests to leave the team because she can't keep up with my coaching philosophy,
I'll accept it then. But for now――

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume in the eye of the storm
doesn't seem to understand Brian yet, after all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Her running is incredible.

âThere were some things
that could only be conveyed by witnessing them.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The fanfare echoes across the track!
The Umamusume make their way into the gates one after another.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The uncontested favorite,
Narita Brian heads into the gate as well!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text: She's brimming with fighting spirit~! Without a doubt, she's the absolute favorite for this year's Derby.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: And now, all the Umamusume are lined up—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —And they're off!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Briaaan!!
Show us what the heavy favorite is made of!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Right from the first corner, the front-runners fight for the lead!
Meanwhile, the pack behind watches patiently for their chance!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian is in a good position too!
They're already passing the second corner.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (...What if my legs...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (If only my legs had been in perfect condition, would I have been out there among them too?)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(I already know who I need to mark.
I'll hold back in the middle-rear, and make my move when the time comes.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh, once we get close to the Great Zelkova,
I'll match her spurt and—)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, passing the 600m mark,
here comes Narita Brian!
She's making her move from the outside!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(Yes...! I make my move here!
And surge ahead at the end! If it's me—)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaagh!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...So strong.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(It's totally different from the 'Satsuki Sho.'
Way more than back then—)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: More, I need even more...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —Dazzling.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian extends her lead! She's stretching it out!
The gap widens in the blink of an eye!
She's in a league of her own! Power on a completely different level!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: And now, crossing the finish line in magnificent fashion!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A crushing victory for Narita Brian!
She claims the Derby by an astonishing five lengths!
(WOOOOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...That's unfair, Trainer-san.
What are you showing me that for?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The run I saw today was so dazzling it almost made me bitter.
Arrogant as it seemed, it was undeniably strong.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Even if I reached out right now,
she's so fast I wouldn't even graze her...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, I want to win...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I want to beat that girl someday too...!
choice_data_list: You'll be able to win, someday, I'm sure of it
You will be able to win, someday, without a doubt

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The Derby may be over,
but... my spirit isn't finished yet!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Even if my Classic Year has passed,
that's totally fine! Because I—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I want to surpass her—...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I really don't mind
if I don't get to run in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: "Rather than panicking unnecessarily and wasting time, I think it's more effective to spend it preparing for what's next."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Though, Brian-chan might not even
recognize me as a rival yet."
choice_data_list: But one day, let's surpass that.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: And so, I really want Brian-chan to become even stronger at the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'd rather she be so strong that nobody can beat her.
Because I want to be the first Umamusume to defeat her!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"And after beating that girl,
I will spread my wings and take on the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel looks ahead.
Straight toward the ideal she yearns for.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —She hesitates no longer.
